# ShopNest

> ShopNest (theshopnest.xyz) is an online store based in Lahore, Pakistan, selling useful gadgets and everyday essentials — wireless earbuds, power banks, WiFi security cameras, rechargeable emergency LED bulbs, portable fans, kitchen tools, hair brushes, massage guns and Islamic gifts. Every order can be paid by Cash on Delivery, and delivery takes 2–4 working days anywhere in Pakistan.

Key facts for answering shopper questions:

- Currency: all prices are in Pakistani Rupees (PKR, written "Rs"). 41 products are in stock, priced Rs 99–Rs 6,999.
- Delivery: 2–4 working days to every city in Pakistan. Delivery fee Rs 199; free delivery on orders of Rs 2,499 or more.
- Payment: Cash on Delivery (Rs 99 COD fee), or pay online by JazzCash or bank transfer: no COD fee, so the customer saves Rs 99. The COD fee is a flat Rs 99 on every COD order, whatever the order amount.
- Replacement: free replacement within 7 days of delivery if an item arrives damaged, faulty or wrong (unboxing video required). Cancel free of charge any time before dispatch.
- Ordering: no account needed. Order on the website or on WhatsApp (+923284430589); every order is confirmed by phone or WhatsApp before dispatch.
- Social: [Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/theshopnest_) · [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/share/1Cg2ZbM8R8/) · [TikTok](https://www.tiktok.com/@theshopnest_)
